استبحروا (form X)
# اِسْتَبْحَرُوا (istabḥarū) /is.tab.ħa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَبْحَرَ (istabḥara)
# اِسْتَبْحِرُوا (istabḥirū) /is.tab.ħi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَبْحَرَ (istabḥara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
